verdict.rationale: Adyen's evidence only shows an MCP server for developers to connect their own LLM client to build integrations (adyen-pos-docs-13, adyen-pos-docs-20, adyen-pos-probe-4) — this is a developer tool, not a built-in AI assistant inside the product that an end user can delegate tasks to. No evidence of any in-product assistant for merchants or POS operators.
